purpose: Explain how customers may form or record a six-line I Ching cast without assuming prior knowledge of 6/7/8/9 or changing lines.

steps: Choose one face as 3/Yang and the other as 2/Yin; keep that convention unchanged for the whole cast.
Toss three coins once for each line.
The first toss is the bottom line; the sixth toss is the top line.
Choose and keep a consistent Yin/Yang face convention.
Toss six coins together and keep their left-to-right order.
Record the first/leftmost outcome as the bottom line and continue upward through the sixth/top line.
SIX_COIN_STATIC.note: This static six-coin arrangement yields a primary hexagram only unless a specific separately defined moving-line rule is used.

steps: Set one of 50 stalks aside and work with 49.
For each change, divide the working stalks into two heaps, take one stalk aside from one heap, count each heap by fours, and set aside the remainders.
Repeat the operation three times for one line.
The remaining working total will be 24, 28, 32 or 36; divide by four to obtain 6, 7, 8 or 9.
Restore the 49 working stalks and repeat for the next line, from bottom to top.
